newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian full lower house resumes budget debate.
newsitem.headline: Italian full lower house resumes budget debate.

text.p: The Italian Chamber of Deputies or lower house of parliament resumed general debate on Monday on the draft 1997 budget law which aims to slash 62.5 trillion lire off next year's budget deficit.
The government is expected to make its reply later in the morning and amendments tabled to the bill are due to be discussed on Tuesday.
The draft budget law is due to complete its passage through the Chamber by November 14 and then to pass to the Senate (upper house). It must be ratified by both houses by the year-end.
